verdict.rationale: Runloop is an API-driven sandbox platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found 404 at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. The evidence shows only llms.txt, markdown docs, SDKs and Cursor rule files, which are adjacent AI-context features, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
